court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Shailaja Suresh Dimber And Anr vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mrs. Shailaja Suresh Dimber, Housewife; Somesh Suresh Dimber, Service
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra Through the Dattawadi Police Station, Pune; Swati Sunny Dimber, Household

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek to quash and set aside FIR bearing C.R. No. 350 of 2016 registered with Dattawadi Police Station, Pune for offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 504, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

legal_principles.principle: The expression 'husband' covers a person who enters into a marital relationship and under the colour of such proclaimed or feigned status of a husband subjects a woman to cruelty.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the expression 'husband' covers a person who enters into a marital relationship and under the colour of such proclaimed or feigned status of a husband subjects a woman to cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: Cruelty means any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that cruelty means any wilful conduct which is of such a nature as is likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to life, limb or health.

outcome.final_order: Ad-interim relief granted vide Order dated 11 th July 2017 as interim relief confirmed by this Court.
